_comment: Arc 5.4 ambient biome/city audio (next steps.md SS7.28) - CC0-licensed looping field recordings from freesound.org, one per ambient layer AODAmbientSoundManager crossfades (pipeline/build_ambient_zones.py). Same content_src/<category>/manifest.json + download script convention as content_src/textures/ground/ (download script + manifest.json ARE committed, fetched audio is NOT - see repo .gitignore). IMPORTANT LICENSE NOTE: each sound's ORIGINAL lossless file (wav/m4a) requires a logged-in freesound.org account to download - this project does not create accounts or store credentials (see repo safety policy), so every entry here is freesound's own public CC0 PREVIEW rendition instead (the same 'preview' audio the sound's page itself streams before any login) - MP3, ~128kbps 'hq' variant, mono/stereo per source. This is a lossy transcode of the CC0 original, not the original bytes, but the CC0 license, authorship and source URL are unchanged and fully attributable; re-running download_ambient_audio.py against these same CDN URLs is deterministic. If a future pass has an authenticated freesound account available, re-fetching the true originals (linked via source_url) would be a strict quality upgrade with no license change.
format: MP3 (freesound.org 'hq' preview rendition, ~128kbps) -> converted to WAV 48kHz on import, see unreal/import_ambient_audio.py

sounds.author: teadrinker
sounds.original_format: WAV, 44100 Hz stereo, 16 bit (login-gated original; preview MP3 fetched instead, see manifest _comment)
sounds.notes: AODAmbientSoundManager::ForestSound - Forest-zone wind/rustling bed (classify_biomes.py Deciduous/Evergreen/Chaparral/Rainforest archetypes). Replaced an earlier pick ('Wind through trees' by NomadApe, freesound id 444921) after verify_ambient_audio.png's waveform showed it was mostly near-silence with one loud 3s gust around 50s - a bad fit for a continuous ambient bed despite being a valid CC0 loop; this asset's waveform/spectrogram are visibly continuous instead.

sounds.author: VKProduktion
sounds.original_format: WAV, 44100 Hz stereo, 32 bit (login-gated original; preview MP3 fetched instead, see manifest _comment)
sounds.notes: AODAmbientSoundManager::CreekSound - waterway-ribbon proximity layer, fades in within WaterFadeInStartM (60 m) of a creek/river edge (pipeline/build_ambient_zones.py's ODA2 WaterwayDistM channel, sourced from build_water_tiles.py's own osm_waterways.json). As of next steps.md SS7.29 this is a distinct layer from lake_shore/LakeSound's own lake-distance channel (previously one combined Water layer/distance signal covered both) - creek_babble stayed the waterway-specific asset because Summit County's road corridor runs along river/creek valleys (Blue River, Tenmile Creek, Snake River) far more than lake shoreline; see lake_shore entry below for the lake-specific layer.

sounds.author: klangfabrik
sounds.original_format: WAV, 44100 Hz stereo, 16 bit (login-gated original; preview MP3 fetched instead, see manifest _comment)
sounds.notes: AODAmbientSoundManager::LakeSound (next steps.md SS7.29) - lake/reservoir shoreline layer, faded by pipeline/build_ambient_zones.py's independent lake-distance channel (ODA2's LakeDistM, from this same osm_water.json polygon source), separate from CreekSound/creek_babble's waterway-distance channel. Sourced and objectively verified (loop-seam/LUFS) as the lake-specific alternate for the 'lapping/shore ambience near lakes' ask; Arc 5.4 originally imported this asset (SW_LakeShore) without wiring it to a distinct layer - SS7.29 is the pass that actually splits Water into Creek vs Lake.

sounds.author: DotAfter
sounds.original_format: WAV, 48000 Hz stereo, 16 bit (login-gated original; preview MP3 fetched instead, see manifest _comment)
sounds.notes: AODAmbientSoundManager::SettlementHumSound - Settlement-zone distant-traffic hum, mix level scaled by classify_settlements.py's archetype (City=255/255, AmericanTown=140/255 - see pipeline/build_ambient_zones.py's SETTLEMENT_DENSITY).

sounds.author: ERR0
sounds.original_format: WAV, 44100 Hz mono, 16 bit (login-gated original; preview MP3 fetched instead, see manifest _comment)
sounds.notes: AODAmbientSoundManager::AlpineWindSound - the base wind bed played under EVERY zone (Open/Alpine both target this layer at full volume; Forest/Settlement layer their own sound on top of it, not instead of it - see class header comment).
